control_flow_certificate.lean_source:
import StorageControlFlow
open Cordis.StorageControlFlow Cordis.StorageProgram Cordis.Persistence
def extracted : Template := {
  publication := [.create, .write, .sync, .rename]
  journal := [.backups, .sync, .rename, .confirm]
  groups := [.base, .states, .overlay, .sources]
  finish := [.syncData, .moveDecision, .syncDecision]
  entry := [.encode, .lock, .prepareKeys, .commitSame]
  restorePresent := [.removeTemporary, .linkJournal, .publishTemporary, .removeTemporary]
  restoreAbsent := [.removeTarget] }
theorem extracted_is_canonical : extracted = canonical := by decide
theorem extracted_covers_all_write_and_backup_lists (before : Image)
    (writes : List Change) (order : List Nat) :
    ∃ t, Execution (initialWithBackupOrder before writes order)
      (compile extracted order writes) t ∧ t.cursor = .committed :=
  source_certificate_covers_arbitrary_loops extracted extracted_is_canonical before writes order
theorem entry_constructs_backup_coverage (p : Prepared) (name : Nat)
    (modified : name ∈ (entryRun {prepared := p} extracted.entry).writes.map Prod.fst) :
    name ∈ (entryRun {prepared := p} extracted.entry).backups :=
  source_entry_derives_backup_coverage extracted extracted_is_canonical p name modified
theorem recovery_restores_arbitrary_names (before image : Image)
    (journal : Nat → Option (Option Nat)) (names : List Nat)
    (complete : ∀ name ∈ names, journal name = some (before name)) :
    sourceReplay extracted journal names image = some (restore before names image) :=
  certified_recovery_restores_every_original_name extracted extracted_is_canonical before image journal names complete
theorem entry_and_recovery_compose (before : Image) (p : Prepared)
    (events : List Cordis.StorageProgram.Event) (markerPersisted : Bool) :
    let entry := entryRun {prepared := p} extracted.entry
    let machine := run (initialWithBackupOrder before entry.writes entry.backups) events
    sourceRecovery extracted (entry.writes.map Prod.fst) machine markerPersisted = some before ∨
      sourceRecovery extracted (entry.writes.map Prod.fst) machine markerPersisted =
        some (applyWrites before entry.writes) :=
  certified_entry_transaction_recovers_old_or_new extracted extracted_is_canonical before p events markerPersisted

import Architecture
namespace Cordis.ArchitectureSourceCertificate
open Architecture
def parsedFilter : MetadataKey → Bool
  | .text key => !(key.startsWith "cordis.")
  | .other _ => true
theorem source_filter_all_keys (key : MetadataKey) :
    parsedFilter key = !reservedKey key := by cases key <;> rfl
def parsedOrigin (generation : Generation) : Origin := ⟨generation.connection, generation.context, generation.instanceId, generation.group, generation.plugin⟩
theorem source_origin_all_generations (generation : Generation) :
    parsedOrigin generation = originOf generation := by rfl
theorem source_filter_all_fields (untrusted trusted : Metadata) :
    untrusted.filter (fun field => parsedFilter field.1) ++ trusted =
      scopedMetadata untrusted trusted := by
  simp only [source_filter_all_keys, scopedMetadata]
def parsedMetadataContext (view manager generation : Metadata) : Metadata := view
def parsedTrustedContext (view manager generation : Metadata) : Metadata := view
def parsedInterface (requested : String) : String := requested
def parsedRequestContext (requested : Nat) : Nat := requested
theorem source_uses_view_metadata (view manager generation : Metadata) :
    parsedMetadataContext view manager generation = view := by rfl
theorem source_uses_view_trusted_identity (view manager generation : Metadata) :
    parsedTrustedContext view manager generation = view := by rfl
theorem source_passes_requested_interface (requested : String) :
    parsedInterface requested = requested := by rfl
theorem source_passes_requested_context (requested : Nat) :
    parsedRequestContext requested = requested := by rfl
theorem source_scope_uses_view_fields (view manager generation trustedView trustedManager trustedGeneration : Metadata) :
    (parsedMetadataContext view manager generation).filter (fun field => parsedFilter field.1) ++
      parsedTrustedContext trustedView trustedManager trustedGeneration = scopedMetadata view trustedView := by
  simp only [source_uses_view_metadata, source_uses_view_trusted_identity,
    source_filter_all_keys, scopedMetadata]
end Cordis.ArchitectureSourceCertificate

import PluginSourceVectors
namespace Cordis.PluginSourceCertificate
open PluginSource
def parsedDefinition (name : String) (dependencies : List Bindings.Dependency)
    (implementation : Payload) : PluginPrinciple.Definition Payload :=
  ⟨name, dependencies, implementation⟩
theorem source_constructor_all_implementations (name : String)
    (dependencies : List Bindings.Dependency) (implementation : Payload) :
    parsedDefinition name dependencies implementation = ⟨name, dependencies, implementation⟩ := by rfl
def parsedRoute (generation : RemoteGeneration Payload Inherited)
    (timeout otherTimeout fallback : Nat) : ApplyRoute Payload Inherited :=
  ⟨generation.connection, "apply", ⟨generation.plugin, generation.component, generation.library, generation.context, generation.config, generation.inherited⟩, timeout⟩
theorem source_route_all_payloads (generation : RemoteGeneration Payload Inherited)
    (timeout otherTimeout fallback : Nat) :
    parsedRoute generation timeout otherTimeout fallback = routeApply generation timeout := by rfl
def parsedAllocate (counter : Nat) : Option Nat × Nat :=
  if counter + 1 ≤ identityLimit then (some counter, counter + 1) else (none, counter)
theorem source_allocator_all_frontiers (counter : Nat) :
    parsedAllocate counter = allocate counter := by
  unfold parsedAllocate allocate WireSemantics.allocateId
  by_cases available : counter < identityLimit
  · have checked : counter + 1 ≤ identityLimit := by omega
    simp [available, checked]
  · have checked : ¬ counter + 1 ≤ identityLimit := by omega
    simp [available, checked]
